name: DS Cluster S43: Monthly Downsample (correct monthly returns)
description: Tests: downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last) for monthly close. forward_returns on monthly grid.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S43: Monthly Downsample
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === MONTHLY CLOSE ===
monthly_close = resample(close, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Last"])

# === MONTHLY RETURNS (sum of daily) ===
monthly_ret = resample(rets, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Sum"])

# === MONTHLY VOLUME (sum) ===
monthly_vol = resample(src.v, target_timeframe=1M, agg=["Sum"])

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Monthly Close",
    category="Monthly",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=monthly_close)

histogram(
    title="Monthly Return Distribution",
    category="Monthly",
    bins=20
)(monthly_ret)
